articles.title: A New Snake Just Got Named After a Rock Star
articles.summary: A brand-new snake species from New Guinea is now called Lielaphis slashi — named after Slash, the guitarist from Guns N' Roses. Turns out Slash has loved reptiles since he was a kid!

articles.title: Your Big Brain Might Be Thanks to Fruit
articles.summary: A new study says sugary foods like fruit and honey may have helped our ancestors grow bigger brains. Four million years ago our ancestors' brains were the size of an apple — today's are much bigger!

articles.title: This Tiny Chip Steers Light Faster Than a Blink
articles.summary: Caltech scientists built a tiny chip that can redirect a beam of light in just 74 quadrillionths of a second — about the time light takes to cross a human hair. It could make computers and internet much faster.
